state_definitions.live: A public listing or install surface was independently resolved.
state_definitions.listed_incomplete: A public listing exists, but a required semantic evaluation is incomplete.
state_definitions.submitted: The third-party operator has received the submission; review or acceptance is pending.
state_definitions.closed_unmerged: The operator closed the submission without merging it; no listing is claimed.
state_definitions.eligible_automatic: The repository meets the operator's automatic indexing rules, but the listing was not observed.
state_definitions.ready_account_action: Technical assets are ready; an account-owned portal, identity, or domain-verification action remains.
state_definitions.release_gated_owner_action: A public tagged release must exist before the account-owned portal, identity, or domain-verification action can begin.
state_definitions.ready_validation: Submission assets are ready, but an operator-specific install test remains before an honest attestation can be made.
state_definitions.paused_external: The operator is not currently accepting submissions.
state_definitions.conditional_artifact: The channel is appropriate only after a destination-specific artifact is produced.
state_definitions.skipped_paid: A paid listing was deliberately not purchased because no spend was authorized.
state_definitions.approved_pending_public: The operator explicitly approved the profile, but an independently accessible public listing has not yet been verified.
